summary.what_it_does: This page is a submission form for the awesome-ai-agents list maintained under the e2b-dev GitHub organization. It accepts (semi)-autonomous AI agents, agent SDKs, AI frameworks, AI tools, and other products built for or around AI agents. The form asks for a product name, tagline, open- or closed-source type, category (such as coding, data analysis, research, multi-agent, or memory management), description, and links to the webpage, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, and founders' profiles. It also asks for an email address for verification and offers an optional opt-in for E2B blog contact.
notable: Submission route for the e2b-dev awesome-ai-agents list
Lists categories from coding to multi-agent and open-source model support
Requires an email so submissions can be verified
caveats: Submission requires a Google sign-in and an email address
Form requires JavaScript to be enabled
Submission does not guarantee the product will be added
